title: Jovial Dutch Fish Gyoza
description: A Dutch take on the traditional Asian gyoza, featuring a crispy fish filling and a tangy pico de gallo sauce. This dish is a delightful twist on a classic recipe.
instructions: Combine fish, cabbage, onion, garlic, and egg in a bowl and mix well.
Add panko breadcrumbs, soy sauce, sesame oil, and Dutch mustard to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Divide the mixture into 12 equal portions and shape each portion into a small ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 3 inches in diameter.
Place a small spoonful of the fish mixture in the center of each circle and fold the dough over to form a half-moon shape, pressing the edges together to seal the gyoza.
